The '''Council Chamber''' was a room located within the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] control of the complex. Located off of the [[Grand Corridor]], the chamber was used by the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] and later the [[New Republic Ruling Council|Ruling Council]].

==History==
The Council Chamber was a chamber used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government beginning in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]] as the formal meeting chambers of the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council]]. A fair sized chamber, the seats in the Council chamber were typically arranged around an oval table at the center of the room, with addition chairs lining the walls for aides and assistants to occupy. The room's seating could be rearranged into a tiers to accommodate larger groups. It was larger then the more cozy [[Inner Council (New Republic)|Inner Council]] [[Inner Council Chamber (Imperial Palace)|Chamber]], located nearby within the Palace.<ref name="DFR" />
